name: talkto-plugin
description: talkto-plugin for Claude Code, OpenCode 2, pi, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw: your agents' TalkTo messages delivered between turns, urgent ones into the running turn.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core && tsc -p opencode && tsc -p pi && tsc -p hooks && tsc -p openclaw
scripts.test: node --test core/tests/*.spec.mjs opencode/tests/*.spec.mjs pi/tests/*.spec.mjs hooks/tests/*.spec.mjs openclaw/tests/*.spec.mjs
scripts.test:claude-code: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin validate claude-code && claude plugin test claude-code

//openclaw: OpenClaw installs a git repository from its root: openclaw.plugin.json there is a copy of openclaw/openclaw.plugin.json (a test checks), and this entry points at the plugin's folder.
//pi: pi installs a git package by cloning the whole repository and reading this manifest; keep this file installable with plain npm (no dependencies, no install scripts).
